summary: Early computer-game artifacts from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: OXO
entries.definitive_edition: Historical EDSAC artifact with simulator/reconstruction notes

emulation.notes: Record simulator build and any reconstruction assumptions.

primary.why: OXO is a 1952 EDSAC noughts-and-crosses artifact, so the archive target is documentation and an EDSAC simulation route rather than a commercial rerelease. It should be logged as a historical reconstruction with input/output limitations noted.
primary.how_to_play: Use an EDSAC simulator or documented reconstruction where available. Record simulator version, display/input method, rules interpretation, and whether the run is a documentation-only historical entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document the simulator or reconstruction and do not treat modern tic-tac-toe clones as OXO.
